fact: On 5 October 2026 the UJT and the National Assembly's communication committee discussed reform of the press laws and access to public information, and agreed to push for adoption of the bill on journalists' safety and protection, lodged with the CNT in 2022; no access to information law is reported adopted.
title: Tchad : l'UJT et l'Assemblée nationale veulent relancer les réformes sur la presse
